title: Successive Viola error identity
statement: For $0\leq\varepsilon\leq1$, define $V(\varepsilon,d)=9\varepsilon^{1/2^{d-1}}$ for each natural number $d$. For every $d\geq1$, $V(\varepsilon,d+1)=3\sqrt{V(\varepsilon,d)}$.
